title: Marker movement under edits

environment.system_features: ACL GMP GNUTLS LIBSELINUX LIBXML2 MODULES NATIVE_COMP NOTIFY INOTIFY PDUMPER SECCOMP SQLITE3 THREADS TREE_SITTER ZLIB

mechanism: Markers preserve a moving position, not a semantic target.
hypothesis: A marker should move when text is inserted before it, while text around the marker may no longer match the original target context.
minimal_fixture: One temporary buffer, one marker before a target character, and two edits before/around it.
predicted_behavior: The marker remains live and moves, but the original semantic context is stale.

independent_checks.name: marker moved after insertion before it

counterexample: Accepting a delayed edit because its marker is live can apply it to the wrong text.
derived_gym_requirement: Delayed edits and FIM suggestions must validate prefix, suffix, buffer incarnation, and target range text before mutation.
